crossRefs.note: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly as this? For all things come from…
But by the grace of God I am what I am. His grace which was given to me was not futile, but I worked more than all of…
We proclaim him, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in…
for which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.
I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.
From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on…
Yes, a man will say, “You have faith, and I have works.” Show me your faith without works, and I will show you my faith…

translations.web: The first came before him, saying, ‘Lord, your mina has made ten more minas.’
translations.bsb: The first servant came forward and said, ‘Master, your mina has produced ten more minas.’
translations.kjv: Then came the first, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained ten pounds.
translations.asv: And the first came before him, saying, Lord, thy pound hath made ten pounds more.
